name: FIS (Fidelity National Information Services)
description: FIS sells the software and processing that sits inside banks and financial firms: core banking systems that hold deposit and loan records, digital banking, card and debit-network processing, fraud tools, and, in its Capital Markets segment, trading, lending, treasury and wealth-management software. Clients pay under multi-year contracts, mostly recurring fees per account or per transaction plus licences and services. FIS sold 55 percent of its merchant-acquiring business (Worldpay) in January 2024, and in January 2026 it swapped its remaining 45 percent stake for the card-issuer processing business (Issuer Solutions, formerly TSYS) bought from Global Payments, so it is now bank and card-issuer technology only. The deal was funded with about $7.7 billion of new debt.

employees.note: "More than 44,000 employees", over 27,000 of them principally outside the US (a floor, not an exact count; before the January 2026 addition of the Issuer Solutions business).

businessLines.name: Banking Solutions
businessLines.how: Banks, credit unions and lenders pay multi-year fees for core account-processing software, digital banking, card and ATM/debit network processing, fraud and risk tools, wealth and retirement recordkeeping and check processing; mostly recurring, priced per account, per transaction or per user.

businessLines.name: Capital Market Solutions
businessLines.how: Asset managers, brokers, insurers and corporate treasurers buy software licences, maintenance, managed services and per-transaction processing; larger share of licence and project revenue than Banking, but also recurring subscription and processing fees.

businessLines.name: Corporate and Other
businessLines.how: Corporate overhead plus a few non-strategic businesses; revenue fell 23 percent after a divestiture.

brands.name: Issuer Solutions (ex-TSYS card issuer processing)
brands.note: Bought from Global Payments, closed 2026-01-09, funded by about $7.7B new debt and the Worldpay stake sale; now in Banking Solutions

brands.name: Worldpay (45 percent stake, sold)
brands.note: FIS sold 55 percent of Worldpay Merchant Solutions to GTCR on 2024-01-31 and the remaining 45 percent stake to Global Payments on 2026-01-09; no longer related
